# Our Luxembourg stops and meals

The owner supplied all eleven visited places and meals in this conversation. The existing confirmed trip runs 22–25 October 2026, so the first, second and third days are recorded as 22, 23 and 24 October. No meal or event is invented for 25 October. The place list is retained without assigning a day, a walking order, an indoor tour, weather, price or exact time.

The first day includes chicken katsu curry in Trier and McDonald's nuggets eaten by the boyfriend alone because Tasya does not like them. The second includes bread in Trier in the morning, Yangguofu Malatang in Luxembourg in the afternoon, and Indomie goreng at the Luxembourg Airbnb at night. The third includes no breakfast, a very good O'Tacos lunch in Luxembourg, and frozen food bought at Aldi Trier for dinner. No dish variation or restaurant location beyond the owner's account is inferred.

Place spelling was checked against the Luxembourg City Tourist Office:

- [Bourbon Plateau](https://www.luxembourg-city.com/en/place/monument/bourbon-plateau) and the French [Plateau Bourbon](https://www.luxembourg-city.com/fr/adresse/monument/plateau-bourbon).
- [City map](https://www.luxembourg-city.com/fr/planifier-votre-sejour/informations-voyageurs/citymap): Pont Adolphe, Place de la Constitution, Place Guillaume II, Place de Clairefontaine and Chemin de la Corniche.
- [Ville Haute](https://www.luxembourg-city.com/fr/a-propos-de-luxembourg-ville/quartiers/ville-haute): district name, Palais Grand-Ducal and Notre-Dame Cathedral of Luxembourg.
- [2026 city guide](https://www.luxembourg-city.com/media/b5145fab-1477-4d4e-a94f-7be75565443e/1082-lcto-bro-city-guide-2026-115x170-final-web.pdf): Hämmelsmarsch fountain by Wil Lofy. The owner described the sculpture; the artist is not part of its place name.
- [City bridges](https://www.luxembourg-city.com/en/about-luxembourg-city/meng-stad-my-city/details/the-10-must-see-bridges-in-luxembourg-city): Pont du Grund, also called the Rue Münster bridge.

These sources verify names, not the couple's attendance; attendance comes from the owner. The existing RE11/L31 map is unchanged and does not pretend to draw their sightseeing route. The places unfold above the map, with no caption beneath it. No tourist or restaurant image is presented as a personal trip photograph.
